DitherSparkline.label: What the trend shows, such as "Revenue, last 30 days". Starts the accessible summary.
DitherSparkline.color: Colour of the line, the fill and the dot.
DitherSparkline.area: Fills the area under the line.
DitherSparkline.level: Gradient only: coverage of the fill just under the line, 0 to 1.
DitherSparkline.bloom: low or high adds a soft glow under the line and the fill.
DitherSparkline.dot: A dot on the latest value.
DitherSparkline.interactive: Scrub with the pointer or the arrow keys to read single values. Escape lets go.
DitherSparkline.domain: The value range the height covers, as { min, max }. Give a row of sparklines one domain to compare them.
DitherSparkline.animate: The line draws in and the fill fades in.
